staticText: Private two-programme bootcamp comparison worksheet requiring a dated HTTPS provider or contract source for each option and one user-chosen currency. Users enter the full payment or income-share obligation, mandatory fees, equipment, monthly access, duration, weekly workload and foregone income. It calculates direct cost, opportunity cost, decision cost and learning hours. An optional payback scenario uses only a user-entered after-tax income uplift and is not a placement, salary or ROI prediction.
